summary: Carry published maintenance custody through sealing and promotion readers.
details: The existing seal writer selects the explicit nine-target source 4.2.1 maintenance contract and carries authenticated published predecessor custody. Promotion reconstruction, offline restore, planning and main readback consume the same identity.
Default seal contracts and all native, programme, trust, signing, source freeze, review, restore and protected promotion checks remain mandatory. Missing evidence prevents a seal write.

Controlled propagation and custody-expression checks create no successful seal, signature, native evidence, promotion or publication. Actual technical acceptance and the release-asset consumer remain outstanding.
